notes: «قال ابن المثنى حدثنا مغيرة بن سلمة المخزومي» names a different transmitter for the route the other shaykhs call أبو هشام, so it is a variant group (rule 4); the two names are not merged (rule 9)
The chain beyond مغيرة is not written in this text
«وأبو هشام حدثنا وهيب» continues the main route; the saying is Aisha's
